Join Monica as she builds DIY craft-struments from everyday items that can be found in a recycling bin. Along for the ride are Pro Musicians and Junior Jammers who visit the backyard for a jam session. Their instruments are the inspiration for Monica’s craftstruments builds. Each episode concludes with Monica and her friends making some Backyard Beats!

Tropical rainforests aren’t widespread in China, but the stunning southern island of Hainan, known as ‘China’s Hawaii’, is a remarkable exception, filled with hugely diverse rainforest habitats. Revealing both breath-taking overviews and hidden gems of the Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park, we track rare and iconic species.

Cameron Daddo and Diana Chan go to Thailand. First they stay at Park Hyatt Bangkok, sample the food and the spa offered by the hotel and also visit a local food market. Then they travel by private plane to the island of Koh Kood and stay at Soneva Kirt, where they enjoy a memorable treepod dining experience.

p.d: Jonathan and Todd enjoy a motorcycle ride before they join diving instructor Anton for an incredible cave dive in a tiny pond behind a toilet paper factory in rural Portugal. After that, the Bird family goes to Sesimbra, Portugal and explores a shipwreck that has become a thriving artificial reef and one of the most popular dive sites in the country.

In this second episode, we're setting out for Africa to find out which snake is the deadliest in the continent. We're to compare their venom, aggression, bites and deaths they cause. There'll be Gaboon vipers, green mambas, pythons, vine snakes, boomslangs, Egyptian cobras, carpet viper, and many more.

p.t: Ascenda - Clinically Shown To Support Catch-Up Growth Presents:Studio 930:Wonder Woman 1984[Eng][PG]

p.d: In this episode, we are in the American states of North and South Carolina. These two states front the Atlantic Ocean, with magnificent forests, beautiful cities, fine plantation houses, and great fields of cotton. There is also a sense of history from the fight for independence from British rule, to the plantation houses that reflect the cruelty of slavery.

In the early 1910s, four performers embark on a perilous journey to an ancient tomb in search of their missing master. Inside the tomb, they encounter various difficulties and experience life and death. In the process, they also discover a mysterious treasure in the tomb and unveils their masters secret.

A Taoist prophecy foretells that the rise of Hei Jiao will threaten the world. As Scholar Lu Dongbin is on his way to end his marriage engagement to Bai, he finds her father missing and Bai possessed. As Lu learns about his immortal identity, he realizes that the encounter with Bai and the incidents that happened are all part of his destiny.

In 1928 Shanghai, a new triad gang plans to expand their territory, causing conflicts with the old triad gang. As the son of the old triad boss seeks revenge for his fathers death, he accidentally makes friend with the new triad boss right-hand man. However, as the two are destined rivals, a fatal battle between them is inevitable!

Pu Song Ling accidentally releases the Black Mountain Demon during his writing. A goddess fights the demon but her body is destroyed, leaving behind her spirit. She borrows the body of Pus wife to continue the fight but they get trapped by the Black Mountain Demon. To save his wife, Pu must touch another three demons heart.

Undercover cop Shan tips Inspector Wai on a USD20 million drug trade that will be dealt directly by drug boss Jin. However, this is a trap set by Jin to find the undercover. When Shans identity is revealed, he is hunted by the drug gang while his police identity has also been deleted. To prove himself a cop, Shan must uncover Jins conspiracy.

In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

SWAT sniper Zhang and his spotter Hu accidentally paralyzed the hostage Li Xiang in an operation. Zhang left the team after and partnered with Li. Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

Huan Yi Village is hit by a strange disease while the Demon Queen controls the Palace, so Chang and Prince Yan are forced to seek out the legendary Nine-colour Deer King to save the people and stop the Demon Queen. Evading the Queens pursuit, they uncover the Deer Kings secret with their allies, restoring peace to the village and the kingdom.

Agula, a friend and coworker of Narcotic agent Yan, is killed by the drug dealer Chi Na. While Yan takes care of Agulas family, he encounters Chi Na who wants to flee the country with the help of Agulas father.

General Huang leads 800 warriors to rescue General Li and other generals trapped by the 100,000 Sha Men troops in Bai Po City. He successfully saved General Li after overcoming various dangers, and stalled Sha Men forces as they await troop reinforcements. In the end, General Li and the 800 warriors heroically safeguard their homeland.

He successfully saved General Li after overcoming various dangers, and stalled Sha Men forces as they await troop reinforcements. In the end, General Li and the 800 warriors heroically safeguard their homeland.

In the Republican period, many sects use sleazy scams to deceive the public. Young maiden Sun Jin, armed escort Li, and the kung fu expert Yang, join forces to uncover the truth behind the widespread deception. However, they soon discover the hidden secrets of Yang and Li. Who amongst them is the true villain?

Drug lords Kun and Hao prosper amidst a corrupt landscape in the 1970s Hong Kong. ICAC officer Rose embarks on a mission to infiltrate Haos gang to gather evidence. However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

Rumour has it that a water monster destroyed the village 20 years ago, and now its vengeful spirit has returned. As Yan and his master encounter mysterious incidents in the village, Yan decides to find out the truth without being influenced by superstitions. In the process, Yan discovers his true identity and captures the real culprit.

Ling Long Town faces frequent natural disasters. Rumour has it that feeding the dragon in the well with children will help. A new imperial scholar wants to investigate the well but is imprisoned for allegedly offending the Dragon Emperor. Xiao Yuan seeks help from Song Ci to rescue the scholar and unravels the truth behind Ling Long Towns mystery.

p.t: The Librarian: The Quest For The Spear
p.d: A bookworm becomes the librarian. Same night a magical spear gets stolen and hes off to get some real life experience around the globe on his quest for the spear - starting with being thrown off a plane over Amazonas by his cute helper.

p.t: The Librarian: The Curse Of The Judas Chalice
p.d: Losing his girlfriend because he was at an auction getting the magical Philosophers Stone, Flynn Carsen is ordered to take a vacation. In New Orleans he finds himself busy protecting the Judas Chalice and saving the world from vampires.
Michael Fassbender stars in this action-adventure film based on the acclaimed video game franchise about a man who discovers hes a descendant of an ancient line of Assassins.

A unique cross-cultural Spaghetti Western where an outlaw and a stoic samurai are forced to team up in the American Southwest to track down a smooth bandit leader who stole a priceless ceremonial sword intended for the US President.
Misanthropic worker Orson detests his lazy colleagues. He finds a secret, magical office that boosts his productivity and status, but his coworkers can’t see the room and grow to resent his success.

Returning to early 20th-century Shanghai to marry his fiancée, Chen Zhen discovers his revered martial arts master has died mysteriously. He launches a relentless quest for vengeance against the rival Japanese dojo responsible.
John Rambo is released from prison by the government for a top-secret covert mission to the last place on Earth he’d want to return - the jungles of Vietnam.
Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

A massive earthquake creates a chain of events that threaten two of the largest nuclear reactors.

Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling.

In *Waterworld*, Kevin Costner stars as a lone maverick in a flooded future Earth, protecting a mother and daughter from a tribe of ruthless nomads. Dennis Hopper delivers a memorable villainous performance in this thrilling adventure.

p.d: Day two in Newport, Rosie and Kelsey sit down for a one-on-one to address their rocky relationship.

p.d: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way.
